messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: ur10e-manual, p. 228

20. Declarations and Certifications 20.2. Certifications UR10e Description Third party certification is voluntary. However, to provide the best service to robot integrators, Universal Robots chooses to certify its robots at the recognized test institutes listed below. You can find copies of all certificates in the chapter: Certificates. Certification Certificates by TÜV Rheinland to EN ISO 10218-1 and EN ISO 13849-1. TÜV Rheinland stands for safety and quality in TÜV Rheinland virtually all areas of business and life. Founded 150 years ago, the company is one of the world’s leading testing service providers. Copyright © 2009–2025 by Universal Robots A/S. All rights reserved. In Canada, the Canadian Electrical Code, CSA 22.1, Article 2-024 requires TÜV Rheinland equipment to be certified by a testing of North America organization approved by the Standards Council of Canada. Universal Robots e-Series robots conform to CHINA RoHS management CHINA RoHS methods for controlling pollution by electronic information products. Universal Robots e-Series robots have KCC Safety been assessed and conform to KCC mark safety standards. The Universal Robots e-Series robots have been evaluated for conformity assessment for use in a work KC Registration environment. Therefore, there is a risk of radio interference when used in a domestic environment. Universal Robots e-Series robots are Delta performance tested by DELTA. Supplier Third As provided by our suppliers, Universal Robots e- Party Series robots shipping pallets comply with the Certification Environment ISMPM-15 Danish requirements for producing wood packaging material and are marked in accordance with this scheme. UR10e 231 User Manual
